summary_1line: Stories explaining several Jyotirlingas—Tryambakesvara, Vaidyanatha, Nagesvara, Ramesvara, and Ghrishnesvara—along with legends of devotion, divine intervention, sacred ash, and rudraksha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana kneels in fierce devotion on a mountain, severing his own heads one by one as offerings while Shiva finally appears before him.
Ganga bursts from Shiva’s matted hair and flows down to the earth as sage Gautama prays beside the spot where the cow fell.
Ghusmala gathers the scattered pieces of her murdered son beside a lake, and the boy miraculously rises alive through Shiva’s grace.
